ref: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx.1
subtopic: Solving by Formula and Completing the Square
setLabel: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx
solution:
\(m^2 - 14m + 13 = 0\) comparing with \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\)

we get \(a = 1\), \(b = -14\), \(c = 13\),

\(\therefore\) \(b^2 - 4ac = (-14)^2 - 4 \times 1 \times 13\)

\(= 196 - 52\)

\(= 144\)

\(m = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\)

\(= \dfrac{-(-14) \pm \sqrt{144}}{2 \times 1}\)

\(= \dfrac{14 \pm 12}{2}\)

\(\therefore\) \(m = \dfrac{14 + 12}{2}\) or \(m = \dfrac{14 - 12}{2}\)

\(\therefore\) \(m = \dfrac{26}{2}\) or \(m = \dfrac{2}{2}\)

\(\therefore\) \(m = 13\) or \(m = 1\)

\(\therefore\) 13 and 1 are roots of the equation.

ref: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx.2
subtopic: Solving by Formula and Completing the Square
setLabel: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx
solution:
\(x^2 + 10x + 2 = 0\) comparing with \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\)

we get \(a = 1\), \(b = 10\), \(c = 2\),

\(\therefore\) \(b^2 - 4ac = (10)^2 - 4 \times 1 \times 2\)

\(= 100 - 8\)

\(= 92\)

\(x = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\)

\(= \dfrac{-10 \pm \sqrt{92}}{2 \times 1}\)

\(x = \dfrac{-10 \pm \sqrt{4 \times 23}}{2}\)

\(= \dfrac{-10 \pm 2\sqrt{23}}{2}\)

\(= \dfrac{2(-5 \pm \sqrt{23})}{2}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = -5 \pm \sqrt{23}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = -5 + \sqrt{23}\) or \(x = -5 - \sqrt{23}\)

\(\therefore\) the roots of the given quadratic equation are \(-5 + \sqrt{23}\) and \(-5 - \sqrt{23}\).

ref: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx.4
subtopic: Solving by Formula and Completing the Square
setLabel: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx
solution:
\(25x^2 + 30x + 9 = 0\) comparing the equation with \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\)

we get \(a = 25\), \(b = 30\), \(c = 9\),

\(\therefore\) \(b^2 - 4ac = (30)^2 - 4 \times 25 \times 9\)

\(= 900 - 900 = 0\)

\(x = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\)

\(= \dfrac{-30 \pm \sqrt{0}}{2 \times 25}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = \dfrac{-30 + 0}{50}\) or \(x = \dfrac{-30 - 0}{50}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = -\dfrac{30}{50}\) or \(x = -\dfrac{30}{50}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = -\dfrac{3}{5}\) or \(x = -\dfrac{3}{5}\)

that is both the roots are equal.

Also note that \(25x^2 + 30x + 9 = 0\) means \((5x + 3)^2 = 0\)

ref: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx.5
subtopic: Solving by Formula and Completing the Square
setLabel: Formula for solving a quadratic equation SolvedEx
solution:
\(x^2 + x + 5 = 0\) comparing with \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\)

we get \(a = 1\), \(b = 1\), \(c = 5\),

\(\therefore\) \(b^2 - 4ac = (1)^2 - 4 \times 1 \times 5\)

\(= 1 - 20\)

\(= -19\)

\(x = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\)

\(= \dfrac{-1 \pm \sqrt{-19}}{2 \times 1}\)

\(= \dfrac{-1 \pm \sqrt{-19}}{2}\)

But \(\sqrt{-19}\) is not a real number. Hence roots of the equation are not real.
